meaning_en: to manage with something inadequate
quote_cn: 但我们只能将就着过。
example: With a third of the budget they just make do.
example_cn: 预算只有三分之一，只能将就。
note: make do with（某物）＝凑合用。make do without=没有也凑合过。

meaning_en: to learn how to do something
quote_cn: 我们年轻老师还在摸索门道。
example: It took me a month to get the hang of the reporting software.
example_cn: 我花了一个月才摸熟那套报表软件。
note: 名词 the hang of sth＝诀窍（近义 knack）。

meaning_en: to survive an ordeal
meaning_cn: 活着出来；总算挺过来了
quote_cn: 我当老师就是为了确保学生能活着走出来。
example: Two hundred candidates came out of the interview alive.
example_cn: 两百个候选人总算面完活下来了。
note: 夸张说法，表示过程摧残但人挺住了。

meaning_en: to feel in control and handling things well
meaning_cn: 得心应手；一切尽在掌握
quote: I finally feel on top of things.
quote_cn: 我终于觉得一切尽在掌握了。
example: After the system upgrade she felt on top of things again.
example_cn: 系统升级后她又一次觉得尽在掌握。
note: 反义 feel out of depth（力不从心）。on top of 还可指「在…之上」。

meaning_en: an alternative if the first option fails
quote: And the rug was Plan B?!
quote_cn: 所以地毯是 B 计划？！
example: If the budget won't stretch, Plan B is a phased rollout.
example_cn: 预算不够的话，B 方案是分阶段上线。
note: 日常口语＝退路。正式商务语境常见。

meaning_en: a place that reduces anxiety
quote_cn: 地毯对孩子来说就像一个让人平静的地方。
example: A quiet room works as a calming space during meltdown.
example_cn: 崩溃期一个安静的房间能起到让人平静的作用。
note: 空间/场所描述的高频组合，职场谈办公环境也用。

meaning_en: a devout, upright woman
meaning_cn: 上帝的女人；虔诚正直的女人
quote: I'm Barbara Howard, woman of God.
quote_cn: 我是 Barbara Howard，上帝的女人。
example: She'd probably describe herself as a woman of God.
example_cn: 她大概会自称是上帝的女人。
note: 宗教圈的自我介绍；常带自嘲意味。

meaning_en: one behind another in a line
quote: Out in the hallway in a single file.
quote_cn: 在走廊里排成单行。
example: Line up single file and follow the teacher.
example_cn: 排成一列跟着老师走。
note: 美国学校常用；英国多说 in a line。

meaning_en: an expert at a hands-on tool
quote: a wizard with a glue gun
quote_cn: 用热熔胶枪的高手。
example: He's a wizard with Excel; ask him anything.
example_cn: Excel 用得问他就行，他是个高手。
note: 结构：a wizard with sth。也可说 a whiz at／a guru at。

meaning_en: the teacher's comment on a school report
quote: She wrote in my report card note
quote_cn: 她在我的成绩单评语里写道……
example: His report card note said 'a joy to teach'.
example_cn: 他的成绩单评语写着「教起来很轻松」。
note: 美式；英式说 school report。报告单本身叫 report card。

meaning_en: too attached and reluctant to leave
quote_cn: 有点黏人。
example: New joiners can come across as clingy in week one.
example_cn: 新人第一周容易显得不合群、黏人。
note: 带负面评价。反义 independent。cling to=紧抓不放。

meaning_en: a person who is very entertaining
quote_cn: 她可太有意思了。
example: Everyone says Marcus is a hoot to work with.
example_cn: 大家都说跟 Marcus 共事特别有意思。
note: 20 世纪早期指笑点，现多用于夸人风趣。

meaning_en: to be routed to the junk folder
quote: It must have gone to spam.
quote_cn: 肯定进垃圾箱了。
example: Your filters sent the offer to spam again.
example_cn: 过滤器又把那份录用通知扔进垃圾箱了。
note: 也作 end up in the spam folder。名词 spam folder。

meaning_en: a bond formed through shared hardship
meaning_cn: 创伤联结；共患难建立的情谊
quote_cn: 所以算是创伤联结吧？
example: Nine people on the same team for two years builds trauma bonding.
example_cn: 同队共事两年会形成一种共患难的默契。
note: 心理学概念，本指被虐待后产生的依恋；职场泛指一起扛过事的关系。

meaning_en: a nickname expressing affection
quote: it's like a term of endearment
quote_cn: 那算是一种昵称。
example: "Big man" is how his crew uses it as a term of endearment.
example_cn: 「大哥」是他队友的昵称。
note: 与 insult（侮辱）相对——同一个词语境不同含义完全不同。

meaning_en: a hundred dollars
quote_cn: 一百美元，大写叫 a C-note。
example: The deposit was two C-notes and he still walked away.
example_cn: 押金是两个 C-note（大写一百），他还是走了。
note: 大写 C 是罗马数字 100。连字＝grand（千美元）。

meaning_en: to apply a veneer of class to something shabby
quote: you can't class up a rug
quote_cn: 地毯是贴不了金的。
example: You cannot class up a cracked vinyl floor with a rug.
example_cn: 一块开裂的地胶盖块毯子也装不出体面。
note: 来自 class 作动词＝「使显得高级」。带轻蔑。

meaning_en: any publicity, even negative, helps
quote: No press is bad press, Barb.
quote_cn: 没有新闻才是坏新闻，Barb。
example: Local papers are running with it — no press is bad press.
example_cn: 本地报纸都在炒这事——没新闻才是坏新闻。
note: 源自 press agent 行业。常用反讽，语境多为批评。

meaning_en: continuing to do very well
quote_cn: 看看梅尔·吉布森，照样滋润。
example: The brand weathered three scandals and is still thriving.
example_cn: 这品牌扛了三次丑闻，照样活得好好的。
note: 此处是讽刺。反义 struggling（艰难维持）。

meaning_en: not given enough money to work
quote_cn: 经费不足、管理不善的公立学校
example: Underfunded programmes always cut the training budget first.
example_cn: 经费不足的项目总是先砍培训预算。
note: 常与 understaffed、oversubscribed 连用。

meaning_en: stay alert behind you
quote_cn: 今早有个学生让我注意身后。
example: On a crowded subway, mind your six.
example_cn: 挤地铁时留意身后。
note: six＝六点钟方向（背后）。军队／警察俚语，日常是玩笑。

meaning_en: to have almost no effect
meaning_cn: 作用跟…差不多（等于没用）
quote: My support was gonna do about as much
quote_cn: 我的支持作用跟那个五号文胸差不多。
example: A polite email will do about as much as a raised eyebrow.
example_cn: 一封客气的邮件效果跟挑眉差不多。
note: 否定语境常接无用的东西，表示「聊胜于无也没有」。

meaning_en: good at solving problems creatively
quote_cn: Melissa 很有办法，能干。
example: He was resourceful enough to build it from spare parts.
example_cn: 他有办法用零件把它拼出来。
note: 形容词来自 resource；职场评价高频，比 smart 更褒义。

meaning_en: to endure until the end
quote: stick it out longer than two years?
quote_cn: 你们怎么都撑不过两年？
example: The first quarter is brutal; most people can't stick it out.
example_cn: 第一个季度很熬，多数人撑不下来。
note: stick it out＝硬撑完。反义 quit。

meaning_en: the rate at which staff leave and are replaced
quote_cn: 人员流动比面包店还勤。
example: Their turnover is double the industry average.
example_cn: 他们的流动率是行业均值的两倍。
note: 此处双关 turnover＝面团翻面／烤制。HR 通用词。

meaning_en: inappropriate; crossing a line
quote_cn: Schwartz 老师做得不合适。
example: His remarks were out of line for a staff meeting.
example_cn: 他那番话在员工会上不合适。
note: 反义 in line。职场批评常用。

meaning_en: to face more opponents than you
quote_cn: 我在里面寡不敌众。
example: In that meeting five directors outnumbered us.
example_cn: 那次会上我们寡不敌众，对面五位董事。
note: 反义 outnumber（数量压过）。

meaning_en: a distinctly original opinion (often ironic)
quote: She has a unique take on her job.
quote_cn: 她对这份工作有独特的见解。
example: His unique take on process management is mostly absence of process.
example_cn: 他对流程管理的独特见解，基本等于没有流程。
note: take＝看法。职场里 unique 常是反话，等于「有问题」。
